0:
set -e
echo "Starting stats refresh at $(date)"

response=$(curl -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-api-key: $${REFRESH_STATS_API_KEY}" \
  -w "\n%{http_code}" \
  -s \
  https://$${SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID}.supabase.co/functions/v1/refresh-stats)

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

echo "Response: $body"
echo "HTTP Status: $http_code"

if [ "$http_code" != "200" ]; then
  echo "Error: Stats refresh failed with status $http_code"
  exit 1
fi

echo "Stats refresh completed successfully at $(date)"

set -e

# Set up PostgreSQL environment variables (same as entrypoint.sh)
export PGHOST="$${INIT_POSTGRES_HOST}"
export PGUSER="postgres"
export PGPASSWORD="$${INIT_POSTGRES_SUPER_PASS}"
export PGDATABASE="$${INIT_POSTGRES_DBNAME}"

echo "Configuring database extensions and permissions..."

# Create extensions
psql -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS \"uuid-ossp\";" 2>&1
psql -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;" 2>&1
psql -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS hstore;" 2>&1
psql -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_stat_statements;" 2>&1

# Grant schema permissions to cookjam_dev
psql -c "GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO cookjam_dev;" 2>&1
psql -c "GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO cookjam_dev;" 2>&1
psql -c "GRANT USAGE, SELECT ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA public TO cookjam_dev;" 2>&1
psql -c "ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES TO cookjam_dev;" 2>&1
psql -c "ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT USAGE, SELECT ON SEQUENCES TO cookjam_dev;" 2>&1

# Grant RLS roles
psql -c "GRANT authenticated TO cookjam_dev;" 2>&1
psql -c "GRANT anon TO cookjam_dev;" 2>&1

echo "Database configuration completed!"
